written: 2026-11-11, before any gate trial (T4 v2: tolerances and classes recorded before trials)
about: tools/method/walkgate.py reads this. Layer 1 = every observed field has a class here; every 'required' pattern is observed. Layer 2 = exact equality after the 'volatile' normalisations only. Layer 3 = the 'trajectory' fields at +3 game s, fresh vs resume, within 'tolerances'; discrete fields exact.

volatile.why: audio noise generators (NoiseLoop / EngineAudio) seed per process: the hiss texture of a sound, read by no check, no step, no gameplay code
wall-clock stamp read only by a test outside the ghat (PlayTest t_ ... 'his honk act'); the ghat walk never honks (no H key in make_ghat.py)

wallstamps.about: wall-clock (Time.get_ticks_msec) fields: compared as 'expired' when older than their window at their own observation, else refused at the boundary (no rebase).

classes.why: LiveControl _snap_live: every plain script var of the ghat node; objects rebuilt by the owner (_spawn_problem) or static (road, builder)
set by Ghat._spawn_problem (the owner path) on restore; observed as a callable on the ghat
_snap_live creature xf
_snap_live creature plain vars; object vars rebuilt by Creature._ready (eyes, mats, hum)
Problem's children are built by Creature._ready; their pose/emission/hum follow its vars: observed directly
xf saved; SaveGame.apply zeroes velocities and unfreezes: a boundary with velocity is refused (engine refusal)
SaveGame saves only tarp; every other VanAttack var must equal its fresh-process value or layer 2 shows it
SaveGame saves a listed subset; engine_on forced off; the rest must equal the fresh-process value or layer 2 shows it
SaveGame saves pos/yaw/pitch/torch/binoculars/seat; LiveControl saves held; the rest must match or layer 2 shows it
SaveGame saves name/kind/xf/litres/slot; velocity zeroed (refused if moving)
SaveGame mood + LiveControl fog re-apply
SaveGame story
SaveGame naresh / live_naresh
process-local queue, pruned only on emit: recent (<2 wall s) or unconsumed events refuse
listener serial: not restored (no rebase); with a listener (Problem) present the restored serial is inconsistent -> refused
statics; equal or layer 2 shows it
static; equal or layer 2 shows it
running tweens (Camper.thump body rock) are not saved: refused when any runs
held inputs at a boundary: refused
open work at a boundary: refused (no watch-budget restore)

unsupported.name: global_rng_problem
unsupported.why: Creature._sniff_t uses the global RNG (randf, Creature.gd 669); its state is not observable or saved: a boundary with Problem out is refused

unsupported.name: coroutines
unsupported.why: no await in Ghat / Creature / Camper / VanAttack / PlayerRig / Carryable (grep 2026-11-11); test helpers: helpers_running

unsupported.name: physics_contacts
unsupported.why: contact pairs live in the physics server: refused while a carryable moves (> 0.05 m/s)

unsupported.name: global_rng_players
unsupported.why: PlayerRig camera shake / shiver use randf: camera wobble only, no check or step reads it; recorded here as accepted, not hidden

trajectory.about: layer 3: these fields at +3 game s, fresh vs each resume. Discrete = exact. Continuous = within the tolerance (units). A tolerance never crosses a check margin: the smallest margin a ghat walk check reads is 0.15 m (the face-glass gap, ghat_looks) and 0.5 m/s (step 6 'stopped'), both above these bounds.
